f_01M12F9W8QCGGY7JRGPZ4VT2ZZ.subject: kitchen_remodel_duration
f_01M12F9W8QCGGY7JRGPZ4VT2ZZ.content: Kitchen remodels typically run 6-10 weeks, per TCR's job-type overview.

f_01M12F9W8RXYDBMXDR8GS92QMV.subject: kitchen_cabinet_lead_pacing
f_01M12F9W8RXYDBMXDR8GS92QMV.content: Cabinet lead time is the pacing constraint for kitchen remodels — cabinets are ordered first and demo is scheduled to land when cabinets ship.

f_01M12F9W8RBQGVR816SM6CH0ZD.subject: kitchen_countertop_templating_rule
f_01M12F9W8RBQGVR816SM6CH0ZD.content: Countertops are templated only after cabinets are installed — never before cabinets and never based on drawings.

f_01M12F9W8RJ05Y0W7K6V81ZW06.subject: custom_cabinet_lead_time
f_01M12F9W8RJ05Y0W7K6V81ZW06.content: Custom cabinets carry a 42-56 day lead time, ordered once the cabinet layout is finalized.

f_01M12F9W8R01NTCT3PBMA9FHPA.subject: countertop_slab_lead_time
f_01M12F9W8R01NTCT3PBMA9FHPA.content: Slab countertops carry a 14-day lead time from template, and templating happens only after cabinets are installed.

f_01M12F9W8RTHCZN72SG3TRCDX2.subject: kitchen_cabinet_install_productivity
f_01M12F9W8RTHCZN72SG3TRCDX2.content: Kitchen cabinet installation is budgeted at roughly 1.5 days with a 2-person crew.

f_01M12F9W8RSPSB5PH7109XCC56.subject: kitchen_cabinet_sub_rule
f_01M12F9W8RSPSB5PH7109XCC56.content: Cabinet installers on kitchens are subbed out rather than done in-house because specialists move faster than the general crew.

f_01M12F9W8R146SS5ER4F1WJFD9.subject: kitchen_countertop_sub_rule
f_01M12F9W8R146SS5ER4F1WJFD9.content: Countertop templating and install is subbed out, typically requiring two separate site visits.

f_01M12F9W8RZ1NV3BF37AP65WQW.subject: kitchen_open_wall_rule
f_01M12F9W8RZ1NV3BF37AP65WQW.content: Walls are never opened in a kitchen remodel unless the customer has a working kitchen alternative staged for the full duration (e.g. microwave/hot plate/fridge in the garage).

f_01M12F9W8RDTEANRHA1XE67VAK.subject: kitchen_cabinet_holiday_lead_risk
f_01M12F9W8RDTEANRHA1XE67VAK.content: Cabinet supplier lead times swing wildly in November/December due to holiday shipping, so kitchens with a late-fall demo start need the cabinet order placed by mid-September.
